1836.body:
**Gated on:** design-vault pins a workflow-core release carrying `scripts/queue-run.js` (none does at v1.3.15) and has dispatched sessions on 3 days since that pin landed — check: `git -C ~/design-vault fetch -q; git -C ~/design-vault show origin/main:.claude/settings.json | grep -o '"ref": *"[^"]*"'; git -C ~/design-vault log -1 --format=%ci origin/main -- .claude/settings.json; for t in $(git -C ~/workflow-core tag --list 'v*' --sort=version:refname); do git -C ~/workflow-core cat-file -e $t:scripts/queue-run.js 2>/dev/null && { echo "first release with queue-run.js: $t"; break; }; done; find ~/.claude*/projects/ -maxdepth 2 -path '*-home-lucmo-design-vault*' -name '*.jsonl' -newermt '2026-10-22 18:08Z' -printf '%TF\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/^/design-vault dispatch days since the v1.3.17 pin: /'` — abandon if: design-vault turns the `suites` module off or no longer runs `node --test`/pytest suites.
**Gate basis:** the 3-day window is #1776's: each day since 13 Oct with design-vault dispatch has 17 or more distinct stand-downs (17, 44, 87, 53), so 3 dispatch days all below 10 is not a chance result, and one or two quiet days could be.

**Gated on:** at least 20 whole-suite or half-suite markers carry `machine.load1AtStart`, spread across start loads from 0 to 20 — check: python3 -I -c "import json,glob,os,subprocess as s;d=s.check_output([\"git\",\"rev-parse\",\"--path-format=absolute\",\"--git-common-dir\"],text=True).strip()+\"/../.claude/tmp/markers/\";L=[(m.get(\"machine\")or{}).get(\"load1AtStart\") for f in glob.glob(d+\".test-*-markers*.jsonl\") for m in map(lambda x:json.loads(x) if \"load1AtStart\" in x and x.rstrip().endswith(\"}\") else {},open(f)) if isinstance(m.get(\"scope\"),dict) and (m[\"scope\"].get(\"full\") or m[\"scope\"].get(\"shard\")) and m[\"scope\"].get(\"modulesRun\") and not m.get(\"ceilingKill\")];L=[x for x in L if x is not None];print(len(L),\"whole/half-suite runs carry load1AtStart; range\",min(L,default=None),\"-\",max(L,default=None))" — abandon if: the fit over those 20 runs predicts no 840 s crossing (this body then closes the ticket), or #2729 makes a whole suite run far enough under 840 s that no load reaches it
**Gate basis:** the 20 runs and the 0 to 20 load spread are this ticket's own data floor from #4757; `load1AtStart` first landed in 6e5453ba4 on 9 Nov, and on 9 Nov the stores held 0 such runs (the reading above), at about 6 whole or half-suite runs a day, so nothing sooner than several days of runs can meet it.

4951.body: **Gate basis:** the lander takes about 100 batches a day (748 members in 7 days), and 21% go red. So 7 days holds about 150 red batches, enough for a p90 of the red path. 1 day holds about 20, too few for a p90.

4961.body:
**Gated on:** 368 queue-ref stays landed or dropped since 2026-11-10T16:13:04Z — check: node scripts/check-time-to-land.js --since 2026-11-10T16:13:04Z --json — abandon if: the lander's isolation path is reverted or replaced before the count is met, so the reading would measure another change
**Gate basis:** the share of stays over 3 × the green p50 since the change is above the 10% a p90 at target allows; baseline 79/557 stays over target (14.2%, `scripts/lib/time-to-land.js` judgeTimeToLand over the 7 days to 2026-11-10 16:13 UTC); target 10% (the stated bound: a p90 at target puts 10% of stays over it, #4951); 95% one-sided, exact binomial, 80% power against the 14.2% baseline; pass = 47 stays over target in n = 368 stays (about 3 days at 110 to 138 stays a day: 557 stays 5 to 10 Nov, and 45 in the first 8 hours after the change); fail at 46 or fewer of 368; time floor none, as 368 stays span more than two daily load cycles at that rate; assumes independent stays (45 stays in 40 batches since the change, `node scripts/time-to-land.js --since 2026-11-10T16:13:04Z`), same mix of work as the baseline
